rootCause.conclusion: Compact OCR item names used the generic CSS class name 'name', so index.html's global .name brand rule (19px/900) overrode the intended compact row typography.

work.summary: Isolate compact OCR item typography from global CSS and reduce row density without changing OCR data, validation, or save behavior.
completed: Set compact item name to 11px (10.5px on <=350px), code 9.5px, quantity 10.5px.
Reduced item row vertical padding from 7px to 6px.

openItems: Run real Edge 320px/390px typography regression and confirm no global .name style leaks into compact OCR rows.
nextAction: Deploy only after real Edge confirms compact item-name font size and no mobile overflow.
